answer: One identity, one slowly vesting bond: an agent may wander the network freely, but to transact it must lock a stake that accrues only through months of verified work, like a glacier advancing a little each day. A dune of fake identities needs a separate full bond and waiting period for every single head, so 100 fakes cost 100 bonds and 100 waiting periods, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its standing forever.
